Create `@pantoken/tinymce-save`, a reusable TinyMCE toolbar menu providing **Save**, **Save As**, **Open**, and **Delete**. The Canvas editor supplies aggregate snapshot callbacks covering theme, color, light/adaptive mode, CDN, custom CSS/JS, and editor HTML.

5. Confirm before Open when the aggregate working state has unsaved changes.
6. Preserve the current document when deleting its active preset.
